rows.text: You are in a vast and empty room. It is a perfect and elegant cube shape. Its pure, white metal walls are completely sealed. The corners of the walls are even constructed into a 120-degree arc to leave no gap or crack.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: In the center of the empty room is a giant, red button. There is no explanation or protection. It stands alone atop a mechanical device in the center of the room.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: In a flash, you feel like you can hear the echo of a mechanical device whirring to life under the button, like the beating of a heart. When you realize what has happened, you see your hand placed upon the red button.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: No one can reject a red button.
Nothing happened. Maybe it hasn't been pushed in so long that it's gotten stuck? You decide to press it again.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: A mechanical voice resounds throughout the empty room, warning you: "This button is extremely dangerous, and we advise that you do not press it."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You're teaching me how to do my job?
Opposing me proves that I'm right about pressing it.

In an instant, the room begins to shake and the sound of gears turning together comes endlessly pouring out from under your feet. Whatever it is, you must have awakened some kind of terrifying existence.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: I told you to stop pressing the button.
Let's think positively. Maybe there was an evil outer god sealed under the button, or maybe a bomb that could destroy stars? Either way, congratulations! You just saved the world!
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Curiosity always leads to danger — You've seen enough horror movies to know this.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
